```{r, include=FALSE}

# Function to take each measure, outcomes, and data, and return a dataframe that
# contains the rows of each outcome controlled for age, sex, race, and ethnicity.
# Does so for a single alpha measure
run_alpha_models <- function(alpha_measure, outcomes, data) {
  # Loop the outcomes, create an lm save in models
  models <- map(
    outcomes,
    ~ lm(
      # as.formula() converts text into a regression formula
        as.formula(
# paste() is just a paste function, take .x and concatenate "" and the alpha
# EX: "weight_change ~ age + sex + race_3 + ethnicity + Shannon"
          paste(
            .x,
            "~ age + sex + race_3 + ethnicity +",
            alpha_measure
          )
        ),
        data = data
      )
  )
  
  # Name each model according to its outcome
  names(models) <- outcomes
  
  # Convert each model into a df cleaned by tidy
  tidy_models <- map(
    models,
    ~ broom::tidy(
      .x, 
      conf.int = TRUE)
  )

  # Take all results and make a df
  results <- bind_rows(
    tidy_models,
    .id = "Outcome"
  )
  
  # Take the results table, name a column after the diversity
  # remove the stuff we dont need and keep just the outcome rows we want
  # (df contains results for all outcomes) This can be made less redundant
  # but theres no point on wasting time 
  results <- results %>%
  filter(
    term == alpha_measure) %>%
  mutate(
    alpha_measure = alpha_measure)
  

  return(results) 
}
```

### Plots
<br>
```{r, include=FALSE}

# function to plot results, prevent repetitive code
plot_results <- function(df, title) {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "Sig", "N.S.")
    )
  
  #df %>%
   # select(Outcome, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, sig)
  
  alpha_plot <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(x = Outcome, y = estimate)
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey20"
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      width = 0.05,
      linewidth = 1.3
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(shape = sig),
      size = 7,
      color = "#5FA3CC"
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("N.S." = 1, "Sig" = 19)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Beta coefficient",
      shape = "Significance",
      title = title
    ) +
    theme_bw()
}

shannon_plot <- plot_results(shannon_results, "Baseline Shannon Diversity")
observed_plot <- plot_results(observed_results, "Baseline Observed Features Diversity")
pielou_plot <- plot_results(pielou_results, "Baseline Pielou Evenness Diversity")
faith_plot <- plot_results(faith_results, "Baseline Faith PD Diversity")

shannon_plot
observed_plot
pielou_plot
faith_plot
```

### Facet Plot
```{r, include=FALSE}

# combine all 4 diversity measures df's
all_alpha_results <- bind_rows(
  "Shannon entropy" = shannon_results,
  "Observed features" = observed_results,
  "Pielou evenness" = pielou_results,
  "Faith PD" = faith_results,
  .id = "Alpha"
)

# Add the significance table to the plot with p value of .05 highlighting the significance, also renames the outcome variables
all_alpha_results <- all_alpha_results %>%
  mutate(
    sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "Sig", "N.S."),
    Outcome = recode(
      Outcome,
      "change_outcome_wt_fnl_3m_BL" = "Weight",
      "change_wc_average_3m_BL" = "Waist circumference",
      "change_avg_systolic_3m_BL" = "Systolic BP",
      "change_avg_diastolic_3m_BL" = "Diastolic BP"
    )
  )

# Create faceted plot
faceted_alpha_plot <- ggplot(
  all_alpha_results,
  aes(x = Outcome, y = estimate)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey20"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    width = 0.05,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = sig),
    size = 5,
    color = "#5FA3CC"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Alpha,
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("N.S." = 1, "Sig" = 19)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Beta coefficient",
    shape = "Significance",
    title = "Baseline Alpha Diversity Predicting Clinical Changes",
    subtitle = "Baseline to 3 months"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}

faceted_plot <- function(results) {
  plot <- ggplot(
  results,
  aes(
    x = Alpha,
    y = estimate
  )
) +
  # Reference line representing no association
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey20"
  ) +
  
  # Confidence intervals
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = conf.low,
      ymax = conf.high
    ),
    width = 0.05,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
    
    
  # Regression estimates
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = sig),
    size = 4
  ) +
  
  # Flip the axes so outcome names are easier to read
  coord_flip() +
  
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Outcome,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  
  # Filled point = significant; open point = not significant
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Sig" = 19,
      "N.S." = 1
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Baseline Alpha Diversity and Clinical Outcomes",
    subtitle = "Baseline to three months",
    x = "Alpha-diversity measure",
    y = "Regression estimate",
    shape = "Statistical significance"
  ) +
    
      
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
  return(plot)
}


  


faceted_alpha_plot2 <- faceted_plot(all_alpha_results)
faceted_alpha_plot2
```


# Prepare models Split by intervention
```{r}
imf_data <- meta_standardized %>%
  filter(Intervention == "IMF")

dcr_data <- meta_standardized %>%
  filter(Intervention == "DCR")

imf_shannon <- run_alpha_models(
  "shannon_entropy_BL",
  outcomes,
  imf_data
)

imf_observed <- run_alpha_models(
  "observed_features_BL",
  outcomes,
  imf_data
)

imf_pielou <- run_alpha_models(
  "pielou_evenness_BL",
  outcomes,
  imf_data
)

imf_faith <- run_alpha_models(
  "faith_pd_BL",
  outcomes,
  imf_data
)


dcr_shannon <- run_alpha_models(
  "shannon_entropy_BL",
  outcomes,
  dcr_data
)

dcr_observed <- run_alpha_models(
  "observed_features_BL",
  outcomes,
  dcr_data
)

dcr_pielou <- run_alpha_models(
  "pielou_evenness_BL",
  outcomes,
  dcr_data
)

dcr_faith <- run_alpha_models(
  "faith_pd_BL",
  outcomes,
  dcr_data
)

imf_results <- bind_rows(
  "Shannon entropy" = imf_shannon,
  "Observed features" = imf_observed,
  "Pielou evenness" = imf_pielou,
  "Faith PD" = imf_faith,

) %>%
  mutate(Intervention = "IMF")

dcr_results <- bind_rows(
  "Shannon entropy" = dcr_shannon,
  "Observed features" = dcr_observed,
  "Pielou evenness" = dcr_pielou,
  "Faith PD" = dcr_faith,
  .id = "Alpha"
) %>%
  mutate(Intervention = "DCR")

prepare_plot_results <- function(results) {
  results %>%
    mutate(
      sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "Sig", "N.S."),
      Outcome = recode(
        Outcome,
        "change_outcome_wt_fnl_3m_BL" = "Weight",
        "change_wc_average_3m_BL" = "Waist circumference",
        "change_avg_systolic_3m_BL" = "Systolic BP",
        "change_avg_diastolic_3m_BL" = "Diastolic BP"
      )
    )
}

imf_results <- prepare_plot_results(imf_results)
dcr_results <- prepare_plot_results(dcr_results)
```
